children: RNS Number : 4949U  Fevertree Drinks PLC  14 September 2026
Notification and public disclosure of transactions by persons discharging managerial responsibilities ('PDMR')

Fever-Tree, the world's leading supplier of premium carbonated mixers, announces that on 11 September 2026, Domenic De Lorenzo, Non-Executive Chair, purchased 44,674 ordinary shares in the Company at an average price of £7.7955 per ordinary share.
Ann Morris-Gibbons, Director of Investor Relations I ann.hyams@fever-tree.com I +44 (0)7435 828138
Oliver Winters, Director of Communications I oliver.winters@fever-tree.com I +44 (0)770 332 9024
Nominated Advisor and Broker – Investec Bank plc

Fever-Tree is the world's leading supplier of premium carbonated mixers for alcoholic spirits by retail sales value, with distribution to over 90 countries worldwide. Based in the UK, the brand was launched in 2005 to provide high quality mixers which could cater to the growing demand for premium spirits, in particular gin, but also increasingly for vodka, rum and whisky. The Company sells a range of carbonated mixers to hotels, restaurants, bars and cafes ("On Trade") as well as selected retail outlets ("Off Trade").
